notes: Paper reports model-independent radio-line limits on ultralight DM radiative decay (lambda ~ 1e-32 s^-1) and annihilation (<sigma v> ~ 1e-30 cm^3 s^-1) over 1020-2700 MHz using Breakthrough Listen GBT data. Emitted values are the approximate flat DECAY-RATE limit from the abstract, not converted to g_agamma (conversion Gamma = g^2 m^3 / 64pi would be needed; approximate g_agamma ~ 1e-6 GeV^-1, far weaker than CAST). Mass axis computed as m = 2*h*nu for two-photon decay: 1020 MHz -> 8.44e-6 eV, 2700 MHz -> 2.23e-5 eV. Actual frequency-dependent limits only shown in Figure 9 (not numerically readable). Limits set at 3-sigma p-value (~99.7% CL, recorded here as 0.95 per enum constraint). NFW halo with local density 0.471 GeV/cm^3 assumed.
